description: `prose kill` (no `cli`) exits 2 with `cli run cancel --help`; nothing is forwarded or billed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: `kill` is not a command; did you mean `prose cli run cancel --help`? A run in progress is cancelled with `cli run cancel RUN_ID`; a job's future runs stop with `cli job delete JOB_ID`. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: Use `cli run cancel RUN_ID`; `prose cli run cancel --help` shows its arguments.
